correctness.rationale: For H=S+hJ, det H=ab(1−c²)+h² and tr(H^T H)=a²+b²+2ab c²+2h². The two positive singular values obey sum sqrt((a+b)²+4h²), difference sqrt((a−b)²+4ab c²), producing exactly the displayed norm when d>0. Sym(H^-1)=H^-T S H^-1 gives positive definite if c<1; at c=1,h≠0 its rank-one kernel violates the injective-map paramonotone criterion. For c=1,h=0 graph inverse of (a+b)uu^T has domain Ru and affine u-perp fibers; direct pairing proves paramonotonicity. Near aligned cancellation det=ab sin²θ+t², numerator→a+b; R=I−(I+H)^−1 is analytic, first differential q[[0,bθ−t],[bθ+t,0]], norm q(b|θ|+|t|), with O((|θ|+|t|)²) uniform local remainder. Independent four-parameter samples of exact matrix singular norms passed; finite checks only corroborate universal algebra.
